claims: Recheck serum sodium and whole blood sodium to confirm and trend severe hyponatremia (125 mEq/L).
Recheck serum creatinine and monitor urine output to assess worsening renal function (creatinine 2.0 to 2.2 mg/dL).
Monitor blood glucose closely and titrate insulin given hyperglycemia (fingerstick glucose up to 333 mg/dL).
Recheck hemoglobin and hematocrit to evaluate anemia (Hgb 10.6 g/dL, Hct 30.2%).
Continue respiratory monitoring and supplemental oxygen for hypoxemia and hypercapnia (pO2 73 mmHg, pCO2 36-59 mmHg).
Monitor arterial blood pressure and heart rate given hypotension and antihypertensive/vasoactive infusions (ART BP mean 76 mmHg).
Recheck ionized calcium and continue calcium replacement for hypocalcemia (ionized calcium 1.07-1.13 mmol/L).
Recheck serum potassium and magnesium and continue replacement for electrolyte abnormalities (potassium 5.0 mEq/L, magnesium 2.4 mg/dL).
Assess neurologic status and mental status given hyponatremia and risk of encephalopathy.
Maintain aspiration precautions and swallowing assessment given altered mental status and dysphagia risk.
